subject: german

rounds.why: “Die Umwelt” means “the environment”. (Don't confuse it with “die Welt” = the world.)

rounds.lie: “Ich sehe die Nachrichten” means “I see the neighbours”.
rounds.why: Wrong: “die Nachrichten” means “the news”. Neighbours would be “die Nachbarn”.
rounds.truth: “Ich sehe die Nachrichten” means “I watch the news”.

rounds.lie: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Tomorrow I will go to a concert”.
rounds.why: “Bin... gegangen” is the perfect tense = “I went”. “Tomorrow I will go” is “Morgen gehe ich / werde ich gehen”.
rounds.truth: “Gestern bin ich zu einem Konzert gegangen” means “Yesterday I went to a concert”.
truths: “Das Oktoberfest” is a folk festival in Munich.
“Ich folge vielen Influencern” means “I follow many influencers”.

rounds.lie: “Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht” means “We needed the holidays by the sea”.
rounds.truth: “Wir haben die Ferien am Meer verbracht” means “We spent the holidays by the sea”.

truths: “Die Koffer packen” means “to pack the suitcases”.

rounds.why: “Der Bildschirm” means “the screen”. (“Der Schirm” on its own can mean umbrella.)
truths: “Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online” means “I spend too much time online”.
